review_type: Independent read-only visual comparison of five generated enhanced reference sheets
review_method: Original and final PNGs inspected with view_image; row/cell counts are manual visual counts, not automated segmentation. SHA-256 and dimensions read without modifying images.
summary: All five retain visible source object types, state-row counts, occupied/empty-cell patterns, and broad facing/pose arrangement. Fragment-only source cells are retained. Artwork shows clearer outlines, lighting, and material details. Minor label punctuation variation is distinct from a lost state or object.
runtime_compatibility: Not claimed or tested. Outputs are RGB generated reference sheets at changed dimensions and scale. Exact sprite pixels, original registration, transparency, native DMI timing/state metadata and runtime equipment alignment are not validated.
